$comment: Single source of truth for every quality gate. scripts/validate-assets.mjs and the ship-check skill both read this file. Changing a number here changes the gate everywhere. Numbers are ceilings unless named *_min.

coreWebVitals.$comment: Field-realistic targets at p75 on a mid-tier Android over 4G, not lab-only numbers.

javascript.$comment: Gzipped. The 3D runtime MUST be a lazy chunk so it never counts against first load.

models.$comment: Per-file, AFTER Draco geometry compression and KTX2 texture compression.

prerenderedStills.$comment: The workhorse. Most 3D on the site is this, not live WebGL.

prerenderedVideo.$comment: Turntables and camera moves. Poster frame is mandatory so nothing pops in.

accessibility.$comment: Non-negotiable. A healthcare-education company shipping an inaccessible site is a credibility failure, not just a compliance one.
